statement: NVIDIA's CEO says OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra was trained on over 100,000 Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems, with 400K GPUs coming online next.
why: A stated frontier training cluster size plus a named follow-on deployment is a direct read on how many current-generation merchant GPUs the largest lab is absorbing.

impact.mechanism: Frontier training runs at 100K+ NVLink72 scale and a further 400K GPUs being brought online keep top-end accelerator and rack-scale fabric demand at capacity.

evidence.excerpt: GPT-6 Astra, trained on ~100K+ NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72.

confidence.basis: Secondary write-up of a single vendor-CEO social post; the other outlets named in the document are syndication of that same post, not independent reporting, and no NVIDIA newsroom confirmation was found.

dispersion: Document notes the post reportedly first cited a larger 300,000-box figure before being deleted and reposted with the lower number, with no official explanation.
